the future of Africa is not only in the hands of African governments but also the hands of think tanks.

the future of the African think tanks depends on the following: (1) The ability of think tanks to adapt to the changing environment and be relevant to the needs of African societies; (2) The ability to develop a culture of learning and innovation; (3) The ability to build and maintain strong networks with the government and other key stakeholders; (4) The ability to generate new knowledge and ideas that will help African governments and societies to achieve the goals of the African Union's Vision 2020
